# Play Store listing

## App name
Feedline: RSS Reader

## Short description
A calm, open-source RSS reader. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

## Full description
Feedline is a quiet place to read the sites you love. Follow any blog or news site with an RSS, Atom or JSON feed, and your articles are saved on your phone, ready to read anywhere, even offline.

OPEN SOURCE
Feedline is free and open source under the MIT license. There are no ads, no in-app purchases and no subscriptions. Read the code, report a bug or suggest an idea at github.com/deepakness/feedline

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There are no accounts and no servers. Your feeds, articles and reading history live only on your phone. Feedline has no analytics and tracks nothing. It connects only to the sites you follow.

MADE FOR READING
• A clean reader with adjustable text size, line spacing, and serif or sans type
• Full article text and images saved for offline reading
• One timeline for everything, with Standard, Compact and Cards styles
• Read articles fade so new ones stand out, or hide them altogether
• Save articles for later; saved articles are never cleaned up
• Fast full-text search, across everything or within one feed

EASY TO SET UP
• Add a feed by typing a site's address, or share a link from your browser
• Import and export your subscriptions with OPML, so you can come and go freely
• Optional refresh on open and in the background
• Choose how long to keep articles, and whether images download on Wi-Fi only

No algorithm decides what you see. You choose what to follow, and articles arrive in order.
